snippet.title: YARG Setlist: Good Kid, Alohaii ft. Shiki Miyoshino, and more
snippet.description:
Wave 6 is here! Check out 6 new songs featuring Good Kid, FoundiT, Creo, The Sterns, Alohaii ft. Shiki Miyoshino, and Heartsick ft. Sapphire Noel available now through the launcher! Just download/update the setlist and the songs will automatically be included in your library when you launch YARG.

Download the YARG Launcher here: https://github.com/YARC-Official/YARC-Launcher/releases

If you're a developer, artist, or band and are interested in contributing to YARG, feel free to join us on Discord, GitHub, or contact us via our email. We are 100% open source and always welcome anyone who wants to contribute!

Interested in getting your music added to the official YARG setlist or a DLC pack? Reach out to yargchartingteam@gmail.com and we'll get back to you as soon as possible!
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Featured Songs:
"Nomu" by Good Kid https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cJvJOsSfVcg
"Front Row Seats (to Watching Your World Burn)" by FoundiT https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YfJjCj_MQvg
"Seasons (feat. Shiki Miyoshino)" by Alohaii https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IsraVV__oG8
"322" by Creo https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JmobbPTaFcw - released under CC BY 4.0.
"About the Author" by The Sterns https://soundcloud.com/thesterns-music/about-the-author
"Sadness (feat. Sapphire Noel)" by Heartsick https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h_8JTr_IVJ4
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Website: https://yarg.in/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/yarg
GitHub: https://github.com/YARC-Official/YARG
